docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
Install, update and troubleshoot Vega's FiveM scripts on Qbox, ESX and QBCore. The badges at the top of every script page show which frameworks it works with, and Browse by framework groups them.

Free scripts

Download from GitHub

Open source. Get the .zip from the script's latest release and install it like any resource.

Install a free script

Paid scripts

Buy in the store

Pay with Tebex, then download the script from portal.cfx.re under Granted Assets.

Install a paid script

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• A FiveM server. OneSync is recommended; it's on by default on current servers.
  • The framework the script is built for.
  • The other resources listed on the script's page. ox_lib is recommended for the nicest notifications, and Qbox already includes it.

docs.title: Installing a script
docs.text:
1. Open the script's page in Docs and follow the latest release link.
  2. Download the .zip file under Assets.
  3. Unzip it into your server's resources folder.
  4. Add the script's items to your inventory (see below).
  5. Add ensure <resource name> to server.cfg, below your framework (see below).
  6. Restart the server.

docs.title: Installing a paid script
docs.text:
Paid scripts are protected with Cfx.re's asset escrow: they only start on servers whose license key belongs to the Cfx.re account that bought them.

  1. Buy the script in the store, logged in with the same Cfx.re account your server's license key belongs to.
  2. Log in at portal.cfx.re, open Assets and download the script from Granted Assets.
  3. Unzip it into your server's resources folder.
  4. Add the script's items to your inventory (see below).
  5. Add ensure <resource name> to server.cfg, below your framework (see below).
  6. Restart the server.

The config and language files stay open, so you can change every setting; the rest of the code is encrypted.

docs.title: Adding items
docs.text:
Where items go depends on your framework and inventory. Each script page shows the exact code for its items.

ESXQBCoreQbox Inventory Where items go Default ESX Run the script's .sql file on your database ox_inventory ox_inventory/data/items.lua Inventory Where items go qb-inventory / ps-inventory qb-core/shared/items.lua ox_inventory ox_inventory/data/items.lua

Item images go in your inventory's image folder, for example qb-inventory/html/images/.

Inventory Where items go ox_inventory ox_inventory/data/items.lua

Qbox uses ox_inventory. Item images go in ox_inventory/web/images/.

docs.title: server.cfg order
docs.text:
Resources start from top to bottom, so your framework and its libraries must come before any script that uses them.

ESXQBCoreQbox 
ensure oxmysql
ensure es_extended
ensure ox_lib          # optional
ensure <script name>

ensure oxmysql
ensure qb-core
ensure [qb]            # qb-inventory and other qb resources
ensure ox_lib          # optional
ensure <script name>

ensure oxmysql
ensure ox_lib
ensure qbx_core
ensure ox_inventory
ensure <script name>

If you installed with the Qbox txAdmin recipe, keep its order and add your scripts at the end.

docs.title: Giving items for testing
docs.text:
Framework Command ESX /giveitem [player id] [item] [amount] QBCore /giveitem [player id] [item] [amount] Qbox (ox_inventory) /giveitem [player id] [item] [amount]

Police jobs on QBCore and Qbox

Scripts that count police usually only count officers who are on duty. If a script says there aren't enough police, make sure the officers have clocked in.

docs.title: Updating a script
docs.text:
1. Check the Changelog on the script's page for anything new you need to set up. Free scripts: download the new release from GitHub. Paid scripts: download the new version from your Cfx.re portal.
  2. Back up your old config files (for example config/config.lua and config/config_server.lua).
  3. Delete the old script folder and put the new release in its place. Don't copy the new files over the old ones, because files can move between versions.
  4. Copy your changed values back into the new config file. Don't copy the old file over it, because new versions can add settings.
  5. Restart the script with ensure <resource name> in the server console, or restart the server.

docs.title: Finding errors
docs.text: If something doesn't work, look at the server console and the F8 console in game. Errors show the resource name, for example [tobs_bankrobbery]. Each script page has a Troubleshooting section for the common ones.

docs.title: Getting help
docs.text:
• Free scripts: open an issue on the script's GitHub repository.
  • Paid scripts: get in touch through the store.

Include your framework, the script version and any error from the consoles.

docs.title: Docs
docs.text: Every script comes with full docs: installation, every setting, how it works and troubleshooting. The free ones are open source on GitHub; premium scripts are sold in the store.

docs.title: Browse by framework
docs.text: Every script lists the frameworks it works with. Scripts that need no framework are Standalone and run on all of them.

docs.title: tobs_bankrobbery
docs.text:
v1.0.1 Qbox · ESX · QBCore 11 languages GPL-3.0

Rob the Paleto Bay bank and all six Fleeca banks. Hack the security panel, open the vault and empty the trolleys before the police arrive.

Installation

docs.title: At a glance
docs.text:
Frameworks Qbox, ESX and QBCore, detected automatically Banks Paleto Bay (B1) and six Fleeca banks (F1–F6) Uses when running ox_lib, ox_target, ox_inventory, qb-inventory, ps-dispatch Languages English, Danish, German, Swedish, Norwegian, Dutch, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Italian License GPL-3.0, free and open source

Formerly tobs_blaine

tobs_bankrobbery replaces the separate tobs_blaine downloads. See the changelog for how to update.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Secure by design

    The server runs every step of the heist and every payout, so mod menus can't skip the hack or fake loot.

    How it works

  • Fun to play

    Laptop hack, thermite at the inner gate, the real bank alarm, deposit boxes to drill, and gold and diamond trolleys.

    Loot and rewards

  • A real chase

    Police alerts and dispatch, plus an optional GPS tracker or dye pack hidden in the loot.

    Police and the chase

  • Built for admins

    Discord logs, an admin reset, restart protection, saved cooldowns and exports for your scripts.

    Server tools

docs.title: Banks
docs.text:
Bank Config name Per trolley Paleto Bay (Blaine County Savings) B1 $40,000–60,000 Fleeca: Alta, Legion Square, Rockford Hills, Great Ocean Highway, Burton, Harmony F1–F6 $30,000–50,000

Every bank has an inner gate with two of the three trolleys behind it. A gold trolley (2×) or diamond trolley (3×) pays 44 gold bars or diamonds instead of cash. Running another Fleeca heist script? Turn the Fleeca banks off with TOB.FleecaBanks = false.

docs.text: Not released yet: tobs_bankrobbery is still being tested, and the download will be on GitHub Releases.

docs.title: 1.0.1 · not released yet
docs.text:
Fixes and additions from playing 1.0.0 on a Qbox server. Tested in game on Qbox.

  • Inner gate at every bank, opened with its own minigame: gate in a bank's minigames, thermite by default. Its timer starts once the minigame is passed, and a failed try keeps the gate shut for another go
  • Two trolleys behind the gate (gateTrolleys), the right ones at Paleto and the Fleeca banks; a trolley behind the closed gate says so instead of doing nothing
  • Gold and diamond trolleys stand behind the gate and pay 44 gold bars or diamonds (one per grab); the loot counter counts them. Both items and their images are in install/. An item your inventory doesn't have is paid as cash
  • Grabbing ends with the money: the animation plays at the speed that empties the trolley in TOB.GrabTime, stops when it's paid out, and keeps counting while the game is alt-tabbed. Looting no longer sometimes does nothing
  • Emptied gold and diamond trolleys stay empty for every player
  • Paleto's vault door opens the right way (vaultTurn per bank)
  • Laptop hack: players are no longer pulled backwards (TOB.LaptopSceneForward)
  • 5 new languages: French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Italian (11 in total)
  • Every bank uses GTA's laptop and drill with tobs_minigames; Paleto has its own cash range ($40,000–60,000)
  • The end log names cash and items separately when a player got both

docs.title: 1.0.0 · 2026-09-28
docs.text:
The first release of tobs_bankrobbery as its own script: the server runs the whole heist, the framework code is shared with the other tobs_ scripts, and trolleys pay by the time spent grabbing. Plus GTA's own minigames and admin tools.

Tested in game on Qbox. QBCore and ESX are covered by the automated tests but haven't been played on a live server yet: please report anything that doesn't work there.

  • Qbox, ESX and QBCore in one resource, detected automatically (TOB.Framework). Qbox and QBCore count only on-duty police (TOB.PoliceOnDuty); items go through ox_inventory or qb-inventory
  • TOB.PoliceJob can be a list of jobs; /bankcoords prints positions for adding a bank; the install/ folder has the items for every inventory

  • The framework code (bridge/) is now shared with the other tobs_ scripts; TOB.PoliceGroup is gone

  • Security: every step and timer runs on the server, so cheaters can't skip the hack, open the vault early, loot before it's open, or keep it open. Grabbing faster pays nothing more, and players drill one deposit box at a time

  • Rewards: a full trolley pays TOB.TrolleyCash ($50,000–80,000) over TOB.GrabTime seconds. TOB.mincash, TOB.maxcash and TOB.MaxPiles are gone
  • Crew takeover when the robber disconnects
  • Any hacking minigame (TOB.HackMinigame)
  • ps-dispatch alerts out of the box, and SV.DispatchAlert for server-side dispatch
  • Events and exports for other resources
  • ox_lib text prompts instead of 3D text (TOB.Prompts)
  • Optional GPS tracker and dye pack in the loot
  • Marked bills with a worth value for QBCore / Qbox laundering
  • Cash and cooldown per bank (Fleeca trolleys now hold $30,000–50,000); banks moved to config/banks.lua
  • Trolleys spawned by the server with OneSync, and the gate uses GTA's door system
  • German, Swedish, Norwegian and Dutch
  • Players who join the server during a heist can loot it too
  • Minigames from tobs_minigames: GTA Online's hacking laptop and drilling screen, GTA V's safe dial and nine more, when tobs_minigames runs; per bank, with GTA's laptop and drill at Paleto
  • Admin tools: heist switch (/tobpause), test mode (/tobtest) and a health check (/tobcheck)
  • Every refusal says why, with the time left on cooldowns
  • Everyone in the bank hears the drill and the vault door
  • TOB.CardTime: time for the card, the laptop and the minigame (150 s instead of a fixed 90 s)
  • Cooldowns survive restarts; the countdown shows for the whole crew; the police blip lasts the whole heist; full pockets don't lose loot; a warning when OneSync is off

Updating from tobs_blaine: delete the old tobs_blaine folder, change ensure tobs_blaine to ensure tobs_bankrobbery in server.cfg, and copy your settings into the new config files. Set TOB.TrolleyCash instead of the old pile settings.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: Gameplay settings are in config/config.lua, the banks in config/banks.lua, and server-only settings in config/config_server.lua. The "auto" settings pick the best system you have running, so most servers only change the heist and reward values.

docs.title: Framework and police
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.Framework "auto" "auto" finds qbx_core, es_extended or qb-core. Or set "qbox", "esx" or "qb" TOB.PoliceJob "police" Qbox / ESX / QBCore job that counts as police. Several jobs: {"police", "sheriff"} TOB.PoliceOnDuty true Qbox / QBCore: only officers on duty count

docs.title: Heist
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.mincops 4 Police needed online to start TOB.hacktime 60000 Hack duration in milliseconds TOB.timer 300 Seconds to loot after the vault opens TOB.VaultCloseDelay 30 Seconds before the vault closes after looting TOB.cooldown 600 Seconds before the bank can be robbed again TOB.MinCrew 1 Robbers needed near the panel to start TOB.CrewRadius 15.0 Meters around the panel that count as near TOB.OneAtATime false Only one heist on the server at a time TOB.GlobalCooldown 0 Seconds after any heist before any bank can be robbed (0 = off)

docs.title: Minigame
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.HackMinigame "ox_lib" "ox_lib" (skill check, skipped without ox_lib), "none", your own function, or a tobs_minigames game such as "hack". Banks can have their own. See Hacking minigame TOB.MinigameDifficulty {"easy", "easy", "medium", "medium"} ox_lib: one entry per round: "easy", "medium" or "hard" TOB.MinigameKeys {"w", "a", "s", "d"} ox_lib: keys the skill check can ask for TOB.CardTime 150 Seconds the robber has for the card, the laptop and the minigame before the heist fails

docs.title: Rewards
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.TrolleyCash {min = 50000, max = 80000} Cash in one full trolley (3 per heist), for banks without their own cash. Every bank that comes with the script has its own: Paleto $40,000–60,000, Fleeca $30,000–50,000 TOB.GrabTime 37 Seconds to empty a trolley. Stopping early pays for the time spent TOB.black false Pay dirty money. ESX: the black_money account. Others: the TOB.blackmoney item TOB.blackmoney "auto" Dirty money item: black_money on Qbox and QBCore (ESX uses its black_money account) TOB.RewardItem "" Pay as an item instead. See Loot as items TOB.RewardItemCount "cash" "cash" or the number of items in a full trolley TOB.MarkedBills false Pay each trolley as one TOB.MarkedBillsItem with its value as worth. See Marked bills TOB.MarkedBillsItem "markedbills" Item used for marked bills

docs.title: GPS tracker and dye pack
docs.text:
See GPS tracker and Dye pack. Both are off by default.

Option Default Description TOB.Tracker.enabled false Hide a GPS tracker in some loot TOB.Tracker.chance 30 % chance per grabbed trolley TOB.Tracker.duration 180 Seconds police can follow the robber TOB.Tracker.interval 5 Seconds between position updates TOB.Tracker.warnRobber true Tell the robber they're tracked TOB.DyePack.enabled false Hide a dye pack in some trolleys TOB.DyePack.chance 20 % chance per trolley TOB.DyePack.loss 0.25 Part of the trolley's value that's ruined TOB.DyePack.dirty true Pay the rest as dirty money TOB.DyePack.smoke 10 Seconds of red smoke on the robber

docs.title: Vault item
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.VaultItem "" Item needed to open the vault. See Vault item TOB.VaultItemLabel "thermite" Name shown to players TOB.VaultItemTime 15000 Milliseconds spent on the vault door

docs.title: Inner gate
docs.text:
Every bank that comes with the script has one. Its minigame is the bank's gate game in config/banks.lua (see Minigames per bank), and gateTrolleys says which trolleys are behind it.

Option Default Description TOB.GateItem "" Item needed at the gate's panel, e.g. "secure_card" (used up per try). "" = none TOB.GateItemLabel "Secure ID Card" Name shown to players TOB.GateHackTime 10000 Milliseconds opening the gate takes after its minigame is passed

docs.title: Animations and grabbing
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.TrolleySpawn "auto" Who spawns the trolleys: "auto" (the server with OneSync, otherwise the leader's game), "server" or "client" TOB.LaptopHack true Laptop hacking animation at the panel (and at the gate when its game is "hack") TOB.LaptopSceneOffset 1.5 Metres above the floor the laptop scene is placed TOB.LaptopSceneForward 0.45 Metres the laptop scene is moved towards the panel. Raise it (0.55, 0.65) if players jerk backwards when the hack starts TOB.VaultItemAnim "thermite" Vault item animation: "thermite" or "weld" TOB.Alarm true Play the bank's alarm (Paleto). Fleeca is silent TOB.StopGrabKey 73 (X) Key to stop grabbing early. false = can't stop TOB.LootCounter true Show the cash (or gold bars / diamonds) grabbed, and heist totals TOB.SpecialTrolleyChance 25 % chance one trolley is gold or diamonds (always one behind the inner gate) TOB.SpecialTrolleys gold 2×, diamonds 3× Per type: model, pile, empty, multiplier, and item / itemCount (default 44 goldbar / 44 diamond per full trolley; item = "" pays cash). See Gold and diamond trolleys

docs.title: Deposit boxes
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.DepositBoxes true Drillable deposit boxes in the vault TOB.DrillItem "drill" Item needed (not used up). "" = none TOB.DrillTime 15000 Milliseconds per box TOB.DrillMinigame {"easy", "medium"} ox_lib skill check while drilling ({} = none), your own function, or a tobs_minigames game such as "drill" TOB.DrillRewards cash (weighted) What a box can hold. See Deposit boxes

docs.title: Interface
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.Locale "en" "en", "da", "de", "sv", "no", "nl", "fr", "es", "pt", "pl" or "it". See Translations TOB.Target "auto" "auto", "ox_target" or "none" (press E) TOB.Prompts "auto" "Press E" prompts: "auto" (ox_lib text UI when running, otherwise 3D text), "ox_lib" or "3d" TOB.Progress "auto" "auto", "ox_lib" or "progressBars" TOB.Notify "auto" "auto", "ox_lib", "mythic_notify", "framework" (Qbox, ESX or QBCore notifications) or "native" TOB.NotifyTitle "Bank Robbery" Title on ox_lib notifications TOB.CoordsCommand "bankcoords" Command that prints your position for adding banks. false = off

docs.title: Police
docs.text: Option Default Description TOB.BuiltInPoliceAlert true Built-in alert and blip. Turn off if your dispatch script handles it TOB.Dispatch "auto" "auto" (ps-dispatch if running, else TOB.DispatchAlert), "ps-dispatch", "custom" or "none". See Dispatch TOB.DispatchAlert empty Your own dispatch call, run in the robber's game

docs.title: Server (config/config_server.lua)
docs.text:
This file is never sent to players.

Option Default Description SV.Webhook "" Discord webhook URL. See Discord logs SV.LogAntiCheat true Also log blocked cheat attempts SV.ResetCommand "tobreset" Name of the reset command SV.CheckForUpdates true Check GitHub for a new version on start SV.BlockBeforeRestart 15 Minutes before a txAdmin restart when new heists are blocked (0 = off) SV.DispatchAlert empty Server-side dispatch or logging when a heist starts. See Dispatch SV.PauseCommand "tobpause" Name of the heist switch command SV.TestCommand "tobtest" Name of the test mode command SV.TestModePayouts false Test heists pay like normal heists SV.CheckCommand "tobcheck" Name of the health check command SV.HealthCheck true Run the health check when the server starts SV.ShowPoliceCount false "Not enough police" says how many are needed and on duty. See Why a heist can't start SV.BankSoundRange 40.0 Meters around the bank where players hear the drill and the vault door

Banks are in TOB.Banks in config/banks.lua. TOB.FleecaBanks = false (in config/config.lua) turns off all 6 Fleeca banks. A bank can have its own cash = {min, max}, cooldown, minigames, gateTrolleys and vaultTurn; Paleto pays $40,000–60,000 per trolley, the Fleeca banks $30,000–50,000. See Adding a bank.

docs.title: Optional features
docs.text: Everything here is off by default, or switches itself on when the resource it needs is running. Defaults and the full setting list are in Configuration; the admin commands, logs and exports are in Server tools.

docs.title: Loot and rewards
docs.text: Feature What it does Setting Grabbing A full trolley pays over TOB.GrabTime seconds; X stops early and keeps what's in the bag TOB.TrolleyCash, TOB.StopGrabKey, TOB.LootCounter Gold and diamond trolleys Sometimes (25%) one trolley holds gold (worth 2×) or diamonds (3×). It always stands behind the inner gate and pays 44 goldbar / diamond for a full trolley, one per grab; the loot counter counts them. item = "" pays cash instead, and so does an item your inventory doesn't have TOB.SpecialTrolleyChance, TOB.SpecialTrolleys Deposit boxes 8 boxes per vault to drill while it's open, once each, with a drill item. Cash, items or nothing, by weight TOB.DepositBoxes, TOB.DrillRewards, TOB.DrillItem Loot as items Pay an item instead of cash. Full pockets never lose loot: players are told to make room TOB.RewardItem, TOB.RewardItemCount Marked bills One bag per trolley with its value on the item ({worth = ...}), for QBCore and Qbox laundering. Needs qb-inventory or ox_inventory; ESX pays cash TOB.MarkedBills

docs.title: Heist rules
docs.text: Feature What it does Setting Crew size Robbers must stand near the panel to start. Without OneSync every online player counts TOB.MinCrew, TOB.CrewRadius Stopping bank chains One heist at a time on the server, and a cooldown on every bank after any heist TOB.OneAtATime, TOB.GlobalCooldown Restart protection Blocks new heists before a txAdmin restart, so nobody loses one halfway. Skipping the restart allows them again SV.BlockBeforeRestart Vault item The robber opens the vault by hand with thermite or a drill, staying near the bank. The item is used up TOB.VaultItem, TOB.VaultItemTime Crew takeover If the leader disconnects, the nearest crew member leads the rest of the heist — Why a heist can't start Every refusal says why, with the time left. "Not enough police" hides the numbers unless you show them SV.ShowPoliceCount

docs.title: Police and the chase
docs.text:
Feature What it does Setting Dispatch ps-dispatch works out of the box; any other dispatch script through a hook TOB.Dispatch, TOB.BuiltInPoliceAlert GPS tracker Some loot hides a tracker: police follow the robber on the map for a few minutes. Needs OneSync TOB.Tracker Dye pack Some trolleys burst into red smoke when the grab ends, ruining part of the money TOB.DyePack Using another dispatch script

Paste the alert call from its documentation into one of these. An error in your code doesn't stop the heist; it shows in the console.

Client-side dispatchServer-side dispatch

In config/config.lua, runs in the robber's game:

TOB.DispatchAlert = function(coords, bank)
    -- your dispatch script's alert, using coords
end

In config/config_server.lua, runs on the server:

SV.DispatchAlert = function(bank, coords, playerId, label)
    -- your dispatch script's server-side alert
end

With ps-dispatch, add camId = 1 to a bank in config/banks.lua to attach a camera.

docs.title: Look and feel
docs.text:
Feature What it does Setting Hacking minigame The minigame before the hack, and the one for the boxes: an ox_lib skill check, none, a tobs_minigames game, or your own function TOB.HackMinigame, TOB.DrillMinigame, TOB.CardTime Minigames from tobs_minigames GTA Online's hacking laptop and drilling screen, thermite, GTA V's safe dial and nine more ensure tobs_minigames Minigames per bank Each bank picks its hack, inner gate and drill game. Every bank comes with GTA's laptop, thermite at the gate and GTA's drill. A gate game other than "hack" plays without the laptop minigames in config/banks.lua Animations and alarm The laptop hack, thermite sparks, the real Paleto alarm, and everyone nearby hearing the drill and the vault TOB.LaptopHack, TOB.VaultItemAnim, TOB.Alarm, SV.BankSoundRange Translations English, Danish, German, Swedish, Norwegian, Dutch, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Italian, all in locales/locales.lua TOB.Locale Your own minigame, and the tobs_minigames games

Any function works as a minigame, as long as it returns true when the player passed:

TOB.HackMinigame = function(bank)
    return exports["my_minigame"]:Start(...) -- see that resource's documentation
end

With tobs_minigames running (ensure it above tobs_bankrobbery), a setting can also name one of its games: "hack", "drill", "safe", "thermite", "keypad", "wires", "lockpick", "fingerprint", "hotwire", "lasers", "keyfiling" or "tracker". The GTA drill replaces the progress bar, since it can't be finished faster than TOB.DrillTime. Without tobs_minigames, or if a GTA screen doesn't load, the normal minigame runs instead.

Per bank, in config/banks.lua:

B1 = {
    label = "Paleto Bay (Blaine County Savings)",
    minigames = {hack = "hack", gate = {type = "keypad", difficulty = "hard"}, drill = "drill"},
    ...

To add a language, copy the en block in locales/locales.lua, rename it, translate it and keep the %s and %d placeholders.

docs.title: Your own banks
docs.text:
The banks live in config/banks.lua: Paleto (B1) and the six Fleeca banks (F1–F6). Turn one off with enabled = false, all Fleeca banks with TOB.FleecaBanks = false, and give any bank its own cash and cooldown.

Adding a bank

Copy a bank's block, rename it (for example B2) and fill in the positions. Stand on each spot in game and type /bankcoords: it prints your position and heading ready to paste.

Setting What it is doors.startloc The "Start bank heist" panel. animcoords is where the player stands gate The security gate: position, closed angle (h) and prompt position (txtloc) vault The vault door and its prompt position prop.first Where the used card is left trolley1–trolley3 The 3 trolley spawns, with angle (h) objects The same 3 spots, used for cleanup doors.secondloc The panel that opens the inner gate (leave it out for a bank without one) gateTrolleys The trolleys behind the inner gate. Default {"trolley1", "trolley2"} (Paleto: {"trolley2", "trolley3"}) vaultTurn Degrees the vault door turns to open: -90 by default, 90 for a door hung the other way (Paleto) label The bank's name in Discord logs minigames This bank's own hack, gate and drill minigame

Banks with other door models can set gateModel and vaultModel (a model name or a hash number).

docs.title: The heist
docs.text:
1. At least TOB.mincops police must be online (on QBCore and Qbox: on duty), and at least TOB.MinCrew robbers must be at the panel.
  2. A player with a Malicious Access Card uses Start bank heist at the bank's security panel (press E, or with ox_target).
  3. The card is used up and police are alerted. At Paleto, the bank alarm starts ringing.
  4. The robber opens a laptop at the panel and plays the hacking minigame: an ox_lib skill check, or GTA Online's hacking laptop when tobs_minigames is running (every bank by default). Failing it, or taking longer than TOB.CardTime, ends the heist.
  5. The hack runs for TOB.hacktime (1 minute by default).
  6. If a vault item is set, the robber has TOB.timer seconds to plant thermite on the vault door, which then burns through.
  7. The vault opens. The crew has TOB.timer (5 minutes) to loot the 3 trolleys, with a countdown at the bank. One trolley stands in front of the inner gate and can be looted straight away; the other two are behind it. Grabbing pays for the time spent, and X stops early. See Grabbing and the deposit boxes.
  8. To reach the two trolleys behind the gate, the robber opens it at its panel with the bank's gate minigame (thermite with tobs_minigames, otherwise the hacking minigame again). Failing it keeps the gate shut, so they can try again. A gold or diamond trolley, when there is one, is always behind the gate.
  9. When every trolley is empty or the time runs out, the vault closes after TOB.VaultCloseDelay seconds. The bank goes on cooldown (TOB.cooldown, 10 minutes). Everyone sees what they got, and the crew's total.

The heist also ends if the robber leaves the bank. If the robber disconnects, the nearest crew member at the bank takes over and leads the rest of the heist. Heists can also be blocked by the global rules, restart protection or an admin's heist switch; the player is always told why.

docs.title: For police
docs.text:
• Every officer gets an alert, and a flashing red blip marks the bank until the heist ends. Officers who go on duty during a heist get the blip too.
  • Officers can lock and unlock the security gate and the vault door.
  • Police can't start or loot the heist.
  • Using a dispatch script? See Dispatch.

docs.title: Anti-cheat
docs.text:
The server runs the whole heist: every step, every timer and every payout. Players' games only ask, so mod menus can't skip steps or fake payouts:

  • The vault only opens when the server says the hack (and the vault item) is done. Nobody can open it early.
  • Trolleys can only be looted while the vault is open, and the two behind the inner gate only after it's open.
  • Trolleys pay for the time actually spent grabbing, never more than the trolley holds, and only at the trolley.
  • Each trolley can be looted once per heist, and a player drills one deposit box at a time, for as long as drilling takes.
  • Only police can lock and unlock the doors. The robber's gate and vault are opened by the server.
  • Starting, looting and drilling check that the player is there. This needs OneSync; without it the console shows a warning.
  • A heist that somehow gets stuck ends automatically, and cooldowns survive restarts.

Blocked attempts can be posted to Discord.

docs.text: Pick your framework once and every tab on this site follows.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
Not released yet

tobs_bankrobbery is still being tested, so the download link below doesn't work yet.

  1. Download tobs_bankrobbery-vX.Y.Z.zip from the latest release.

  2. Unzip it into your server's resources folder, so you get resources/tobs_bankrobbery/.

  3. Add the items. The install/ folder has them ready for every inventory:

    Item What for id_card_f Malicious Access Card: starts a heist (used up) drill Opens the deposit boxes (not used up; or set TOB.DrillItem = "") goldbar, diamond What the gold and diamond trolleys pay. Skip them if you already have them. Without them, those trolleys pay cash secure_card, thermite Only if you set TOB.GateItem / TOB.VaultItem

    Item images for id_card_f, diamond and secure_card are in install/images/.

    QboxESXQBCore

    Copy the items from install/ox_inventory.lua into ox_inventory/data/items.lua:

    ['id_card_f'] = {
    label = 'Malicious Access Card',
    weight = 10,
    stack = true,
    close = true,
    description = 'A cloned access card used to breach bank security systems.',
},

    Copy the images from install/images/ into ox_inventory/web/images/, then restart ox_inventory so it knows the new items.

    Default inventory: run install/esx.sql on your database.

    ox_inventory: copy the items from install/ox_inventory.lua into ox_inventory/data/items.lua.

    qb-inventory: copy the items from install/qb-core.lua into qb-core/shared/items.lua:

    id_card_f = { name = 'id_card_f', label = 'Malicious Access Card', weight = 10, type = 'item', image = 'id_card_f.png', unique = false, useable = false, shouldClose = true, description = 'A cloned access card used to breach bank security systems.' },

    Put an image for each item in your inventory's image folder, for example qb-inventory/html/images/.

    ox_inventory: copy the items from install/ox_inventory.lua into ox_inventory/data/items.lua instead.

  4. Set your police job in config/config.lua:

    QboxESXQBCore

    TOB.PoliceJob is your police job's name (default "police"). Several jobs: {"police", "sheriff"}. Only officers who are on duty count (TOB.PoliceOnDuty).

    TOB.PoliceJob is your police job's name (default "police"). Several jobs: {"police", "sheriff"}.

    TOB.PoliceJob is your police job's name (default "police"). Several jobs: {"police", "sheriff"}. Only officers who are on duty count (TOB.PoliceOnDuty).

  5. Add it to server.cfg, below its dependencies:

    QboxESXQBCore 
    ensure ox_lib
ensure qbx_core
ensure ox_inventory
ensure ox_target     # optional
ensure tobs_minigames  # optional
ensure tobs_bankrobbery

    ensure es_extended
ensure ox_lib        # recommended
ensure ox_target     # optional
ensure tobs_minigames  # optional
ensure tobs_bankrobbery

    ensure qb-core
ensure [qb]          # qb-inventory and other qb resources
ensure ox_lib        # recommended
ensure ox_target     # optional
ensure tobs_minigames  # optional
ensure tobs_bankrobbery

    Then let admins use the commands (reset, heist switch, test mode and health check):

    add_ace group.admin command.tobreset allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobpause allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobtest allow
add_ace group.admin command.tobcheck allow

  6. Running another Fleeca heist script? Set TOB.FleecaBanks = false in config/config.lua so the two don't clash.

  7. Restart the server. A few seconds later the console shows the health check: all good, or what to fix. Type /tobtest in game to try a heist on your own.

The framework is found automatically

If the console says No framework found, move ensure tobs_bankrobbery below your framework, or set TOB.Framework to "qbox", "esx" or "qb".

docs.title: Giving players the access card
docs.text:
The script doesn't hand out cards. The card is used up each heist, so price it with that in mind.

QboxESXQBCore
  • Admin command: /giveitem [player id] id_card_f 1
  • Shop: add id_card_f to an ox_inventory shop (ox_inventory/data/shops.lua)
  • Other scripts: crafting, drops or missions
  • Admin command: /giveitem [player id] id_card_f 1
  • Shop: add id_card_f to a black-market shop (for example esx_shops or ox_inventory shops)
  • Other scripts: crafting, drops or missions
  • Admin command: /giveitem [player id] id_card_f 1
  • Shop: add id_card_f to a shop in qb-shops (or an ox_inventory shop)
  • Other scripts: crafting, drops or missions

docs.title: Updating
docs.text:
Delete the old folder, unzip the new release, then copy your changed settings into the new config/ files. Check the changelog for anything new to set up.

Coming from tobs_blaine

tobs_bankrobbery is the new name of tobs_blaine. Delete the tobs_blaine folder, change ensure tobs_blaine to ensure tobs_bankrobbery in server.cfg, and copy your settings into the new config/config.lua. The items and the /tobreset command are the same.

docs.title: Server tools
docs.text: For the people running the server: what gets logged, which commands admins have, and how other resources can follow the heists.

docs.title: Commands and checks
docs.text:
Tool What it does Setting Discord logs A message when a heist starts and ends (with each player's payout), on admin resets, and when the anti-cheat blocks something SV.Webhook Admin reset /tobreset [bank] closes the vault, removes the trolleys and clears the cooldown SV.ResetCommand Heist switch /tobpause [reason] stops new heists server-wide; /tobpause off allows them again SV.PauseCommand Test mode /tobtest lets one admin run heists with no rules, no cooldown and no pay SV.TestCommand, SV.TestModePayouts Health check Lists missing items, resources, permissions and settings on start and with /tobcheck SV.HealthCheck Update check Says in the console whether you have the latest version SV.CheckForUpdates For other resources Events and exports so dispatch, MDT or admin scripts can follow the heists —

Admin commands need the add_ace lines from Installation, or run them from the server console.

Events and exports 
AddEventHandler("tobs_bankrobbery:heistStarted", function(bank, playerId, coords) end)
AddEventHandler("tobs_bankrobbery:vaultOpened", function(bank) end)
AddEventHandler("tobs_bankrobbery:heistEnded", function(bank, reason, totalCash) end)
Export Returns IsHeistActive(bank) true while that bank (or any bank, without an argument) is being robbed GetHeist(bank) {stage, leader, started, label} or nil GetBanks() a list of {bank, label, active, cooldownLeft} ResetHeist(bank) resets the bank like /tobreset, returns true

All on exports.tobs_bankrobbery.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Check the server console and the F8 console first. Errors show tobs_bankrobbery.

Type /tobcheck first: the health check lists missing items, resources, permissions and settings in the server console. It also runs a few seconds after the server starts.

docs.title: Starting a heist
docs.text:
“Not enough police” but police are online
  • Qbox / QBCore: only officers who are on duty count. Clock in, or set TOB.PoliceOnDuty = false.
  • Your police job or group has a different name. Set TOB.PoliceJob in config/config.lua.
  • To test on your own, use /tobtest: it skips the police, crew and cooldown rules.
No “Start bank heist” prompt
  • Police can't start heists.
  • With ox_target running there's no floating text: target the panel. TOB.Target = "none" brings back press E.
  • The bank is on cooldown or already being robbed.
“You need 2 robbers at the panel (1 here)”

TOB.MinCrew is set above 1. More robbers need to stand within TOB.CrewRadius meters of the panel.

“Bank heists are paused”

An admin paused heists with /tobpause. /tobpause off allows them again, and so does a server restart.

“The city restarts soon”

A txAdmin restart is scheduled within SV.BlockBeforeRestart minutes. Set it to 0 to turn this off.

Fleeca heists clash with another script

Set TOB.FleecaBanks = false to keep only Paleto.

docs.title: Items, inventory and payouts
docs.text:
“You don't have a malicious access card” but I have one

The item must be named exactly id_card_f. See Installation.

“You need a drill to open the deposit boxes”

Add a drill item to your inventory, or set TOB.DrillItem = "" so no item is needed.

Items aren't found on QBCore

If ox_inventory is running, the items must be in ox_inventory/data/items.lua; otherwise in qb-core/shared/items.lua. See Installation.

“Your pockets are full”

The player's inventory can't take the loot items. They can make room and keep grabbing; a deposit box stays closed so it can be drilled again.

Payouts are too high or too low

Each trolley pays its bank's cash (in config/banks.lua; TOB.TrolleyCash for banks without one) when fully grabbed; a heist has 3 trolleys plus the deposit boxes. A gold or diamond trolley pays 44 items instead (itemCount in TOB.SpecialTrolleys). The end log in the console and on Discord shows what every player got, for example $199,363 ($100,123 cash, 44 × diamond): the total counts the items at their trolley's value.

A gold or diamond trolley pays cash, not gold bars or diamonds

The item isn't in your inventory yet, so the script pays cash rather than nothing. Add goldbar / diamond from the install/ folder and restart your inventory (ox_inventory only reads its items when it starts).

“Open the inner gate to reach the trolleys behind it.”

Two trolleys are behind the inner gate. Open it at its panel first. If a trolley in front of the gate says this, its gateTrolleys in config/banks.lua don't match your vault.

docs.title: Minigames, prompts and notifications
docs.text:
The minigame doesn't appear

The default minigame needs ox_lib. Put ensure ox_lib above ensure tobs_bankrobbery, use another minigame, or turn it off with TOB.HackMinigame = "none".

The ox_lib skill check shows instead of GTA's laptop, the drill or thermite

Those games come from tobs_minigames. Start it above tobs_bankrobbery in server.cfg. Without it, or if a GTA screen doesn't load, the normal minigame runs on purpose.

Error about progressBars

Without ox_lib the script uses progressBars. Install either one.

No notifications

Set TOB.Notify to what you run, for example "ox_lib", or "native" for GTA notifications.

docs.title: Admin commands and logs
docs.text:
No permission for /tobreset, /tobpause, /tobtest or /tobcheck

Add the add_ace lines from Installation to server.cfg, or run the command in the server console (not /tobtest: it's for players in game).

Discord logs don't arrive

Check SV.Webhook in config/config_server.lua is the full URL and the webhook still exists. The logs are also printed in the server console.

“Bank … is missing … and was skipped” in the console

A bank in TOB.Banks is missing a setting (for example after a copy-paste). The console names the bank and the missing settings. The other banks keep working.

docs.title: Server setup
docs.text:
“No framework found” in the console

tobs_bankrobbery started before your framework. Move ensure tobs_bankrobbery below ensure qbx_core, es_extended or qb-core, or set TOB.Framework in config/config.lua.

Error: attempt to index a nil value (global 'Bridge')

No framework was found when the script started. See “No framework found” above.

“OneSync is off” in the console

Add set onesync on to server.cfg. Without OneSync the server can't see where players are, so the anti-cheat can't check that players are at the bank.

Police don't see the GPS tracker

TOB.Tracker needs OneSync (the server sends the robber's position). The console warns at startup when it's off.

docs.title: Models and animations
docs.text:
Gold or diamond trolleys look like cash trolleys

Their models are from game build 2060. Set sv_enforceGameBuild 2060 (or newer) in server.cfg; they still pay their gold bars or diamonds either way.

The vault door opens the wrong way (into the wall or the vault)

Set vaultTurn on that bank in config/banks.lua: -90 (the default) or 90 for a door hung the other way, like Paleto's.

The vault room or doors look wrong

Check that stream/v_int_41.ytyp is inside the tobs_bankrobbery folder.

The laptop or thermite animation looks off

Animations are placed from the bank's positions in the config, so a custom bank may need tuned positions. Turn them off with TOB.LaptopHack = false or TOB.VaultItemAnim = "weld", and please report it on GitHub.

Still stuck? Open an issue on GitHub with your framework, version and the error.

Twelve minigames your scripts can open with one line of code, including GTA's own drill, hacking laptop and safe dial.

Download Installation Source

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text: Download from GitHub Releases.

docs.title: 1.0.0 · 2026-09-29
docs.text:
The first version: twelve minigames for any script.

  • The minigames: GTA's own drill, hacking laptop and safe dial, plus thermite, keypad, wires, lockpick, a Casino-style fingerprint cloner, hotwire, lasers, key filing and a tracker sweep. Easy, medium and hard for each.
  • For scripts: client exports, Play on the server with honest results, trackers on vehicles, and events for logs.
  • Each web minigame is one real object with GTA's key bar; three looks and your own colours.
  • /minigame, a test menu with every game.
  • English, Danish, German, Swedish, Norwegian and Dutch.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: Every setting is in config.lua, explained next to it. After a change, run restart tobs_minigames in the server console.

docs.title: General
docs.text: Setting Default What it does MG.Locale "en" Language: en, da, de, sv, no or nl MG.Difficulty "medium" Used when a script doesn't pick a difficulty MG.Sounds true GTA's hacking sounds in the web minigames MG.TestCommand "minigame" The test command's name; false turns it off MG.StartupMessage true The start line in the server console; false = quiet MG.Intro 5 Seconds of the "how to play" card before a game starts by itself; 0 = no card MG.Scale 1.0 Size of the web minigames. 1.0 takes the same share of the screen on any resolution MG.TextSize 1.0 Bigger or smaller text, for example 1.2 MG.ReducedMotion false true: no shaking or blinking

docs.title: Looks
docs.text:
MG.Style: "default" (each game is one real object), "terminal" (the same objects as green lines on black) or "glass" (frosted and see-through).

MG.Theme puts your own colours (any CSS colour) on top: accent (the test menu's highlights), background (the how-to card, the result and the menu), text, muted (small text), good (right answers), bad (mistakes) and gold (the lockpick's sweet spot).

MG.Theme = {good = "#3e7bfa", gold = "#b58cff"}

docs.title: Animations
docs.text:
What the player does while a web minigame is open, so others can see it:

MG.Animations = {
    thermite = "tablet", fingerprint = "tablet", lasers = "tablet", tracker = "phone", keypad = "keypad",
    wires = "repair", hotwire = "hotwire", lockpick = "kneel", keyfiling = "kneel",
}

Per game: "tablet", "phone", "keypad", "repair" (the hands), "kneel", "hotwire" (in a car) or false. MG.Animations = false turns them all off; a script can skip one call's with {animate = false}.

docs.title: Trackers on vehicles
docs.text:
MG.Sweep = {distance = 4.0, difficulty = "medium", scan = 3000, notify = true}

distance: metres from the car a player can sweep it. difficulty: when the script that put the tracker on didn't pick one. scan: milliseconds a car without a tracker is scanned before "none found". notify: GTA notifications for the result.

docs.title: Server checks
docs.text:
MG.MinTime is the fastest a Play answer may come back before it counts as failed, in milliseconds per game:

MG.MinTime = {lockpick = 2500, wires = 3000}

Games you leave out use a built-in guess: the drill's time minus 1 s, 1.5 s per safe number or fingerprint print, 4 s for the hack, the keypad code's or thermite pads' show time plus 0.5 s, 2.5 s for lasers, the time to file every cut to the shallowest depth, and 1 s for the rest.

docs.title: Each minigame
docs.text:
Each game's table has its settings, then what easy, medium and hard change. A value outside those three (like the drill's time) counts for every difficulty:

MG.Lockpick = {
    easy = {pins = 3, zone = 0.18, speed = 0.7, lives = 3},
    medium = {pins = 4, zone = 0.13, speed = 1.0, lives = 2},
    hard = {pins = 5, zone = 0.09, speed = 1.4, lives = 1},
}

Every game's settings and defaults: The minigames.

docs.title: Playing a minigame
docs.text:
Every game has an export with the game's name: Drill, Hack, Safe, Thermite, Keypad, Wires, Lockpick, Fingerprint, Hotwire, Lasers, KeyFiling, Tracker. Start takes the name in lower case ("keyfiling").

-- CLIENT: wait for the result (inside a thread)
local passed = exports.tobs_minigames:Wires("hard")
local passed = exports.tobs_minigames:Start("thermite", "easy")

-- CLIENT: or get it in a callback (returns at once)
exports.tobs_minigames:Hotwire("easy", function(passed) end)

-- SERVER: use this when the result pays out
local passed = exports.tobs_minigames:Play(source, "safe", "hard")

Settings for one call: nothing (MG.Difficulty), "easy" / "medium" / "hard", or a table with a difficulty plus any of the game's settings:

exports.tobs_minigames:Lockpick({difficulty = "hard", pins = 6})
Extra setting What it does fallback = "lockpick" If a GTA screen (drill, hack, safe) doesn't load, play this game instead, at the same difficulty (your other settings aren't passed on) animate = false No animation on the player (when your script plays its own) animation = "tablet" Another animation: "tablet", "phone", "keypad", "repair", "kneel", "hotwire" seed = 4 The same puzzle every time (web games; for testing)

The keypad also takes code = "4721", a code the player already knows, with show = 0 so it isn't shown first. The drill can never be finished faster than its time, so use it instead of a progress bar: Drill({time = 15000, fallback = "lockpick"}).

The result: true passed; false failed, gave up, died, or another minigame was already open; nil a GTA screen didn't load (and there was no fallback).

Also on the client: IsActive() (is a minigame open?) and GaveUp() (did the last web minigame, or any game's "how to play" card, end with Esc? Esc inside the drill, hack or safe doesn't count).

docs.title: From the server: Play
docs.text:
Play(playerId, name, opts[, cb]) runs the game in the player's game and gives you the result on the server. It only accepts one answer, from that player, and not faster than the game can be played (MG.MinTime). If the player leaves or nothing comes back within 10 minutes, it's false. Why this matters.

local passed = exports.tobs_minigames:Play(source, "keypad", "hard")
exports.tobs_minigames:Play(source, "keypad", nil, function(passed) end)

docs.title: Trackers on vehicles
docs.text:
-- SERVER: put one on; anything in the table comes back as info
exports.tobs_minigames:SetVehicleTracker(vehicle, {difficulty = "hard", job = jobId})  -- true / false
exports.tobs_minigames:GetVehicleTracker(vehicle)      -- the info table, or nil
exports.tobs_minigames:RemoveVehicleTracker(vehicle)   -- true / false

AddEventHandler("tobs_minigames:trackerRemoved", function(playerId, vehicle, info)
    -- info.job: stop the police GPS
end)

-- CLIENT: sweep for it, for example from an ox_target option
exports.tobs_minigames:SweepVehicle(data.entity, function(removed, reason) end)

vehicle can be the entity or its network id. SweepVehicle also returns true when the tracker was removed, and the player gets a notification either way. reason: "removed", "missed" (the tracker stays), "no_tracker", "too_far" (MG.Sweep.distance), "gone" (someone removed it first), "no_vehicle" or "busy".

docs.title: Events
docs.text: Event Side You get tobs_minigames:finished client name, result: any minigame ended tobs_minigames:played server playerId, name, result, ms, reason: a Play ended; reason is "answered", "too_fast", "left" or "no_answer" tobs_minigames:trackerRemoved server playerId, vehicle, info: a tracker was removed tobs_minigames:trackerMissed server playerId, vehicle, info: a sweep failed

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
Command Who What /minigame everyone The test menu; /minigame wires hard plays one game straight away /tobtracker hard admins (add_ace group.admin command.tobtracker allow) A test tracker on the nearest car

The test commands give nothing. MG.TestCommand = false turns /minigame off.

docs.title: The minigames
docs.text:
Every game has an easy, medium and hard setting; scripts pick one per call, else MG.Difficulty (medium). Each starts with a "how to play" card, shows its keys in GTA's key bar at the bottom right, and Esc gives up.

The tables show the defaults, with each setting's name in config.lua. Change them there, or pass your own for one call.

docs.title: GTA's screens
docs.text: GTA's own drill, laptop and safe, with the game's name, the depth, time or lives at the top and short messages when something happens.

docs.title: Drill
docs.text:
GTA Online's Fleeca drilling screen. Push through 4 lock pins without overheating; pins break with a jam, the camera shakes and controllers vibrate. W / S push and pull, A / D change the speed. It can never be finished faster than its time, so use it instead of a progress bar.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Heat when cutting fast (heat) 0.22 0.3 0.4 Cooling (cool) 0.25 0.25 0.2

Also: time (15000 ms, the shortest drill), minSpeed, pins (depths where pins break), shake.

docs.title: Hack
docs.text:
GTA Online's hacking laptop from the Pacific Standard job: HackConnect.exe, then BruteForce.exe (the password in the moving columns). Both share one set of lives. The mouse, the arrow keys and Enter.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Wrong picks allowed (lives) 7 5 3 Time (timeLimit) 90 s 70 s 50 s

Also: ipConnect = false skips HackConnect; background (0 FIB, 1 Pacific Standard, 2 Humane Labs, 3 Los Santos, 4 blue, 5 Merryweather, 6 blue 2); columnSpeed; words (the passwords).

docs.title: Safe
docs.text:
GTA V's safe dial with its tumbler sounds. Turn to each number, then turn back when it clicks. A / D turn, hold Shift to turn slowly.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Numbers (numbers) 2 3 4 How close to the number (tolerance) 3 2 1 Wrong turns allowed (lives) 3 2 1 Time (time) 75 s 60 s 50 s

Also: speed, slowSpeed, and animate = true for GTA's safe cracking animations on the player.

docs.title: Thermite
docs.text:
Pads light up on the charge's panel for a moment. Press the same ones from memory.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Grid (size) 5 × 5 6 × 6 7 × 7 Pads that light up (squares) 5 7 10 Shown for (show) 3 s 2.5 s 2 s Wrong presses allowed (mistakes) 2 1 0 Time (time) 15 s 12 s 10 s

docs.title: Keypad
docs.text:
A code shows on the keypad's display for a moment. Type it and press Enter. A script can also give a code the player already knows (code = "4721", show = 0).

Setting Easy Medium Hard Digits (length) 4 5 6 Shown for (show) 3 s 2.5 s 1.8 s Time (time) 20 s 15 s 12 s Tries (attempts) 3 2 1

docs.title: Wires
docs.text:
Cut the wires in the order of the clues on the sticky note. A wrong cut fails. Each wire has a marker sleeve with its colour's name, for colour-blind players (labels).

Setting Easy Medium Hard Wires (wires) 4 5 6 Wires to cut (cuts) 2 3 4 Time (time) 25 s 20 s 15 s

docs.title: Lockpick
docs.text:
A marker sweeps along the scale under the lock. Press Space (or click) while it's in the sweet spot, once for every pin.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Pins (pins) 3 4 5 Sweet spot width (zone) 0.18 0.13 0.09 Sweeps per second (speed) 0.7 1.0 1.4 Picks that can break (lives) 3 2 1

docs.title: Fingerprint
docs.text:
Clone prints like the Casino heist's hack. Pick the 4 pieces of the print on the right with the arrow keys (or W A S D) and Space, or click them, then check with Tab. When the scramble timer runs out, the pieces are shuffled and your picks cleared.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Prints to clone (prints) 1 2 3 Wrong pieces (decoys) 4 4 6 Time for all prints (time) 40 s 60 s 75 s Wrong checks allowed (lives) 3 3 2 Scramble every (scramble) never 25 s 15 s

docs.title: Hotwire
docs.text:
Click a wire, then the terminal with its colour's name. On medium and hard the names are printed in other colours. In a car, the player plays GTA's hotwire animation.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Wires (wires) 3 4 5 Names in other colours (tricky) no yes yes Wrong connections allowed (mistakes) 2 1 0 Time (time) 20 s 16 s 12 s

docs.title: Lasers
docs.text:
Cross the room on a floor plan with W A S D or the arrow keys, through the openings in the laser walls. Touching a laser costs a life and sends you back. Every room is checked to be crossable in time.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Laser walls (walls) 3 4 5 Moving beams (sweepers) 0 1 2 Laser speed (speed) 0.5 0.7 0.9 Opening size (gap) 0.35 0.28 0.22 Touches allowed (lives) 3 2 1 Time (time) 40 s 35 s 30 s

Also: move (the player's speed).

docs.title: Key filing
docs.text:
Pick a cut (Left Right or a click), then hold Space to file it down to its line. Too deep ruins the key.

Setting Easy Medium Hard Cuts (cuts) 4 5 6 How close to the line (tolerance) 0.06 0.045 0.03 Filing speed (speed) 0.3 0.4 0.5 Keys you can ruin (lives) 3 2 1 Time (time) 45 s 40 s 35 s

docs.title: Tracker
docs.text:
Sweep the car with the mouse while the RF detector shows the signal, and click where the tracker is. The car's own electronics give false signals on medium and hard. Used for trackers on vehicles.

Setting Easy Medium Hard False signals (decoys) 0 1 2 How close the click must be (radius) 0.07 0.055 0.04 Wrong clicks allowed (lives) 3 2 1 Time (time) 40 s 35 s 30 s

docs.title: When a script opens a minigame
docs.text:
1. A script calls an export, for example exports.tobs_minigames:Wires("hard"), or the server calls Play.
  2. A "how to play" card shows for MG.Intro seconds (Space or a click starts sooner). For GTA's screens it comes once the screen has loaded.
  3. The player plays. During a web minigame their character animates (a tablet, a phone, a keypad, the hands, kneeling or hotwiring), so other players see it.
  4. The script gets the result: passed, failed (also on Esc or death), or nothing if a GTA screen didn't load.

Only one minigame can be open at a time; a second call fails straight away.

docs.title: GTA's screens and web minigames
docs.text:
The drill, hack and safe are GTA's own screens, drawn by the game. The other nine are web minigames drawn on a page in the game (NUI), in the look set by MG.Style.

GTA's screens can fail to load on some game builds. Give a fallback (for example {fallback = "lockpick"}) so another game plays instead; without one the result is nil.

docs.title: Keeping results honest
docs.text:
A minigame runs in the player's game, so a cheater can fake the result, as with every FiveM minigame.

  • Client exports are fine for things that don't pay out, like a door the player could open anyway.
  • When the result pays out, use Play on the server. It accepts one answer, from that player, and not faster than the game can be played (MG.MinTime).

Your script should still check what matters for the payout, such as the player's position and the job's step.

docs.title: Trackers on vehicles
docs.text: For car boosting and stolen car jobs. Your server puts a GPS tracker on a car (SetVehicleTracker); it stays on the car when it changes hands. A player sweeps the car (SweepVehicle) and plays the tracker minigame. If they pass, the tracker is removed and your script gets tobs_minigames:trackerRemoved; if they fail, it stays and you get trackerMissed. The code: Trackers on vehicles.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: None: no framework, database, items or other resources. It works the same on Qbox, ESX, QBCore, vRP or no framework.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
1. Download tobs_minigames-vX.Y.Z.zip from the latest release.

  2. Unzip it and put the tobs_minigames folder in your server's resources folder, so you get resources/tobs_minigames/.

  3. Add it to server.cfg, above any script that uses it (for example tobs_bankrobbery):

    ensure tobs_minigames

  4. Optional, for admins: the test tracker command.

    add_ace group.admin command.tobtracker allow

  5. Restart the server. The console says [tobs_minigames] 1.0.0 started. Test every minigame in game with /minigame.

The default settings work as they are. Everything you can change is on the Configuration page.

docs.title: Test it in game
docs.text: Type /minigame for the test menu: every game with its last result, a difficulty and look to test with, Play all (Esc stops it), and a test tracker on the nearest car (admins, step 4). /minigame wires hard plays one game straight away. Results also go to F8; nothing is given or taken. MG.TestCommand = false turns it off.

docs.title: Updating
docs.text:
1. Download the new zip.
  2. Keep a copy of your config.lua.
  3. Replace the tobs_minigames folder, then put your settings back into the new config.lua (new versions may add settings).
  4. Restart the server.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Check the server console and F8 first: every result is printed in F8, and errors show tobs_minigames. The quickest test is /minigame.

docs.title: Starting
docs.text:
/minigame does nothing

MG.TestCommand is false or renamed in config.lua, or tobs_minigames isn't started (check ensure tobs_minigames and the start line in the server console).

/tobtracker says I'm not allowed

Add add_ace group.admin command.tobtracker allow and make sure you're in that group.

A script says tobs_minigames isn't running

ensure tobs_minigames must come above the scripts that use it in server.cfg.

docs.title: Playing
docs.text:
A minigame fails straight away

Another minigame is already open: only one at a time.

The drill, hack or safe doesn't show

GTA's own screens can fail to load on some game builds. The script gets nil, or plays its fallback if it gave one. Scripts that use these three should always give a fallback.

The mouse or keys don't work after a minigame

They come back by themselves when a game ends, after Esc and after dying. If not, restart tobs_minigames gives them back; report it with the F8 log.

The minigames are too small, too big, too hard or too easy

MG.Scale sets the size and MG.TextSize the text. Scripts pick the difficulty per call, else MG.Difficulty; every game's values are in config.lua (defaults).

The player's animation clashes with my script's own

Call the minigame with {animate = false}, or change the game in MG.Animations.

docs.title: Scripts
docs.text:
Play says failed, but the player passed

The answer came back faster than the game can be played (the server console warns): lower that game's MG.MinTime. Or the player left, or took over 10 minutes.

Someone found the tracker too easily, or never

The difficulty comes from the script that put it on, or MG.Sweep.difficulty; the game's values are MG.Tracker.

docs.title: Still stuck?
docs.text: Open an issue on GitHub with your framework, game build, what you did, and the lines from the server console and F8.
